independent.summary: LEO-077's motivation misstates the cost of a missed tick for weekly entities: `isDueNow` has no weekday check (unlike `digestDue`), only an hour match plus the SIX_DAYS_MS gap, so a weekly entity that misses its hour becomes due again 24 hours later at the same hour — not "another 7 days". An implementer taking the prose as the spec could encode a 7-day weekly expectation that the existing code never had.
